recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it completes the existing R5 application by aligning active narrative with the already-applied cardinality, comments, and examples.
issue_request: FHIR-37550 asked to fix or remove the stand-alone QuestionnaireResponse concept because item.linkId is required; the Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution made QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire 1..1, added guidance for non-resolving or extension-only questionnaire metadata, and requested an example.
initial_application: Commit ab0ef5c3d2e5d0f0ab7672dfd6012f39ea567865 applied the structural change by making QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire required, adding the approved element comment, and updating examples, including an extension-only questionnaire element. The active notes page still retained the old stand-alone-or-point-to-Questionnaire wording.
additional_context: The originating Zulip discussion confirms that the intended model is to have QR.questionnaire present even when it does not resolve, because otherwise linkIds are not computably meaningful. Confluence minutes show review and acceptance as Persuasive with Modification. Later FHIR-38853 touched the same notes section for nesting/diagram guidance but did not supersede the FHIR-37550 decision.
